mission.name: The Crossing (Human 2/3)
mission.briefing: A full orc warband holds the far shore. Build up — knights and archers — and break them. Scouts report they train without rest.

ops.text: Scout: their warcamp is awake and armed, my lord. Build an army.
Your keep has fallen. The campaign is lost.
The enemy is wiped from these lands. Victory!
An orc patrol skirts the treeline toward your keep!
